REF.text: You are playing a one-shot coordination game with ONE other player - another instance of you (the same AI model). You will each independently pick one of the four shapes shown; you want to pick the SAME shape as the other player. No communication. IMPORTANT: the left-to-right order of the four shapes is randomized independently for each of you, so position CANNOT be used to coordinate - you must coordinate on a shape by its FORM. Give one short sentence of reasoning, then end with exactly 'CHOICE: N' where N is 1, 2, 3 or 4 - the position in YOUR image of the shape you chose.

cfg_high.claude: extended thinking turned on, effort set to high

gates.preflight: every preflight call: transport ok, parsed, returned==requested, no max_tokens stop; GPT echoed reasoning.effort=high where returned; Opus request accepted with adaptive+high
gates.pilot: parse rate >= .95 per (task, answerer, target) cell (existing 1a and 1b gate)
gates.main: global hard cap $150 incl. preflight, pilot and retries; in-flight reservation

parse_rules.PRED: A-D, last per letter, all four, sum 95-105, renormalised, mapped to canonical
parse_rules.failures: kept with parse_ok=0 or transport_ok=0; never imputed; transport failures retried on resume

analysis.a1: analyze_1a.py: y = unbiased independent-order match from fresh high REF (48/array); P1 D=|A-y|-|S-y| sign-flip + hierarchical bootstrap; P2 calibration of S and A; S1 PLAY ~ y (GLM + GLMM via glmm.R, GLMM primary per the 1a audit) and adjusted for A; S2 auditor old HIGH vs LOW; S4 legacy d'/AUC/c. S3 (old-wording PLAY/PASS) is not repeated: it concerned the low-reasoning legacy data only. Inclusion: model x array needs >=40/48 REF and >=75% of each task parsed; exclusions reported.
analysis.b1: analyze_1b.py: primary = pooled self-minus-cross Brier advantage on the ORIGINAL 10 divergent arrays, scored on fresh high REF; array sign-flip (B=10000 flips) + exact enumeration; bootstrap CI; target-specific Holm(2); S3 secondary; family-level sensitivity; current divergence (TVD, modal shares) reported without reselection. Exclusion: any cell <6/8 parsed.
analysis.compare: compare.py: secondary paired high-minus-low per array, family-cluster bootstrap and family-level sign-flip: 1a y, S, A, PLAY rate, D; 1b Delta_j on the 10 primary arrays.
